versions.changelog: Four new guide themes — Green Mountain (deep forest green and Vermont gold), Harvest Gold, Burnt Orange, and Cherry Red — 7 themes total. The settings dropdown and guide switcher pick them up automatically, and the one-click Apply-theme works for all four. Everything else from 0.3.0.3 unchanged.

Settings page is now fully generic and simpler: no Dayz paths, no Wallingford zip default (weather zip is blank until you enter your own), no personal references anywhere in the UI, errors, or logs — and no library setup on this page at all, because Live TV pulls everything from the guide and needs no library. Everything else from 0.3.0.2 is unchanged (Getting-started box, copyable tuner links, one-click theme apply).

Full 155-channel lineup (2,982 seed items) with the user-uploaded tier live, old-school commercial breaks (one 30-60 s vintage spot at most once an hour per channel, toggle on the settings page, default ON), 96 h guide window, and additive catalog refreshes that only ever grow the guide. Audiobooks is not served (MP3-only, no audio-only stream path yet).
Channel guide — deterministic 48 h schedules, BackWhen-shaped lineup, themeable guide page, M3U + XMLTV, live ffmpeg streams, weather channel, folder.jpg write.
